title: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston’s skid to 5
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Red Sox's Willson Contreras hit his 24th home run, but Boston lost 6-4 to the Blue Jays.
Toronto scored five runs in the eighth inning, with key hits by Kazuma Okamoto and Myles Straw.
Red Sox's loss marks their fifth consecutive defeat; Blue Jays strengthen AL wild-card position.

title: Allston-Brighton residents divided over future of Jackson Mann Community Center, survey shows
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A city survey shows Allston-Brighton residents divided on Jackson Mann Community Center's redevelopment options: housing, school, or both.
Mayor Michelle Wu will decide the center's future by year-end; new survey will gather input until September 10.
Construction on the new community center won't start until 2030, with a temporary relocation after 2028.

title: Tour the Patriots’ new 160,000-square-foot training facility
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The New England Patriots unveiled the 160,000-square-foot New Balance Athletics Center, next to Gillette Stadium.
The facility features a 15,000-square-foot weight room, hydrotherapy amenities, and a 10,500-square-foot virtual reality room.
The center includes a restaurant-like dining area, player lounges, and empty rooms for future football operations adaptations.

title: Man killed in stabbing inside South Station during rush hour, officials say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A man was fatally stabbed during rush hour inside South Station on Wednesday evening, police reported.
The victim was involved in an altercation on an escalator and later died in the hospital, authorities stated.
The suspect is described as a male and remains at large, with an active investigation underway, officials said.

title: Body found at TD Garden, police say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Boston police found a deceased person near TD Garden on Wednesday evening after responding to a report of an unconscious person.
The incident occurred around 5:15 p.m. near 100 Legends Way, the address of TD Garden in Boston.
The body was found inside the parking garage adjacent to TD Garden, though details are still under investigation.

title: Athol man charged with child pornography possession
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Kristopher Ambrozewicz, 35, of Athol, charged with possession of child sexual abuse materials, federal prosecutors announced.
Authorities seized several electronics from Ambrozewicz's home after finding child sexual abuse videos on his cell phone.
Ambrozewicz faces up to 20 years in prison if convicted; arraignment set for Worcester Federal Court on Thursday.

title: Police: Person held pregnant woman hostage with gun during dramatic chase on I-93 in Milton
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A pregnant woman was held hostage with a gun during a police chase on I-93 in Milton.
The suspect, Dominic Hampton-Boyd, crashed into eight vehicles before being apprehended near exit 11.
Hampton-Boyd is scheduled for arraignment in Quincy District Court, charges have not been specified.

title: Stoughton town manager contradicts police chief who accused him of tampering with Sandra Birchmore investigation
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Town Manager Thomas Calter denies Police Chief Donna McNamara's allegations of tampering with the Sandra Birchmore investigation.
McNamara filed a lawsuit claiming Calter pressured her to resign and made discriminatory comments.
Calter and McNamara are on administrative leave pending investigation into the allegations.

title: Nearly 30 people arrested after investigation into drug trafficking in Western Mass.
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: 28 people arrested in Chicopee, Holyoke, and Springfield after a months-long drug trafficking investigation.
Operation Pinky Promise led by FBI Western Mass Gang Task Force seized over 12 firearms and illegal drugs.
The operation involved undercover purchases and surveillance to dismantle drug trafficking in Holyoke and Springfield.

title: Patriots stock watch 2.0: Who’s rising and falling ahead of preseason opener?
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Drake Maye and DeMario Douglas showed strong performances with multiple big gains in joint practices with the Colts.
Romeo Doubs excelled in recent practices, highlighted by a standout touchdown catch over Christian Gonzalez.
Behren Morton is expected to play in the preseason opener as Drake Maye and Tommy DeVito see limited action.
